label: context.reference
text:
Use the GitHub Application through world_mcp_github. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for GitHub repositories, code, issues, pull requests, releases, and workflows that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_github.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_github, label mcp.operation.request, operation github.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use github.read_resource, github.get_prompt and github.complete with catalog identifiers; use github.status or github.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
